api_keys_explanation.text: The API Keys tab is where you configure access to different AI providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others. Each provider offers different models with unique capabilities.

api_providers_overview.text: Cognotik supports multiple AI providers including OpenAI for GPT models, Anthropic for Claude, Google for Gemini, Groq for fast inference, and many others.

auto_fix_explanation.text: Auto Fix enables the AI to automatically attempt to correct errors that occur during code execution, making the development process more robust and self-healing.

auto_fix_task_explanation.text: Auto Fix Task combines command execution with automatic error correction, running commands and fixing any issues that arise during execution.

autonomous_mode_explanation.text: Autonomous mode lets the AI automatically plan and execute complex development tasks with minimal guidance. It can break down large objectives into smaller tasks and execute them independently.

autonomous_settings_explanation.text: Autonomous mode includes settings for task history limits, maximum tasks per iteration, and total iteration limits to control the AI's execution scope.

basic_chat_alternative.text: Alternatively, the Basic Chat button provides quick access to a simple chat interface for immediate AI assistance without the full configuration process.

chat_mode_explanation.text: Chat mode provides interactive task execution where you work directly with the AI, giving it specific instructions and seeing immediate results. This is ideal for focused, individual tasks.

code_execution_task_explanation.text: Code Execution Task lets the AI run code snippets and scripts, testing functionality and debugging issues in real-time.

cognitive_model_overview.text: Cognotik uses a cognitive task mode model where you first choose how the AI should approach your work, then configure the specific tools and settings it will use.

configure_model.text: Next, we will configure our AI model settings. We are selecting Claude three point five Haiku for both the main model and parsing model.

demo_complete.text: This completes our demonstration of the Cognotik file modification task. The AI successfully understood our request, planned the execution, and created the file with content as requested.

demo_start.text: Welcome to the Cognotik App demonstration. Today we will show you how to create and run a file modification task using our AI powered interface.

enable_autofix.text: Auto fix is enabled to automatically correct any issues that might arise during task execution.

enter_command.text: we will enter our command. Create a new file called test.txt and write a short story in it. This demonstrates the AIs ability to understand natural language instructions.

execute_task.text: Now we will execute the task and watch as the AI carries out the file creation and writing process.

file_modification_task_explanation.text: File Modification Task allows the AI to create new files or modify existing code with intelligent assistance, maintaining code quality and consistency.

file_search_task_explanation.text: File Search Task performs pattern-based searches across project files with contextual results, helping the AI understand and navigate large codebases.

generate_directory_demo.text: The generate directory button creates a new timestamped directory in your Documents folder, keeping each session organized and separate.

github_search_task_explanation.text: GitHub Search Task performs comprehensive searches across GitHub repositories, code, issues, and users to find relevant examples and solutions.

goal_oriented_mode_explanation.text: Goal Oriented mode focuses on achieving specific outcomes through iterative planning and execution, adapting the approach based on results and feedback.

insight_task_explanation.text: Insight Task analyzes code and provides detailed explanations of implementation patterns, helping you understand complex codebases and architectural decisions.

intro_welcome.text: Welcome to Cognotik, an advanced AI development platform. This introduction will guide you through all the features and capabilities of the launcher interface.

introduction_conclusion.text: This completes the introduction to Cognotik's launcher. You now understand the cognitive modes, task settings, available task types, and how to configure and launch your AI development sessions.

launch_button_explanation.text: The Launch AI Session button starts your configured development environment, taking you to the appropriate interface based on your chosen cognitive mode.

launch_session.text: With our settings configured, we can now launch the task session.

local_tools_explanation.text: The Local Tools tab allows you to register command-line tools and scripts that the AI can use during task execution, extending its capabilities beyond built-in functions.

model_selection_explanation.text: Model selection lets you choose which AI model to use for main tasks and which for parsing and analysis. Different models have different strengths, costs, and capabilities.

plan_ahead_mode_explanation.text: Plan Ahead mode works with you to create detailed plans before execution, giving you more control over the process while still leveraging AI planning capabilities.

review_configuration.text: The launch page shows a summary of your cognitive mode, task settings, and API configuration, allowing you to verify everything is set up correctly.

select_single_task.text: First, we will select single task mode to focus on one specific operation.

select_task_type.text: Now we will select the File Modification Task, which allows the AI to create, edit, and manage files in our project.

set_temperature.text: We will set the temperature to zero point two for more consistent and focused responses.

shell_command_task_explanation.text: Shell Command Task enables the AI to execute command-line operations safely, allowing it to run builds, tests, and other development tools.

step1_cognitive_modes.text: Step one is choosing your cognitive mode. This determines how the AI will approach and execute your tasks.

step2_task_settings.text: Step two is configuring your task settings. These control how the AI models behave and where they operate.

step3_task_types.text: Step three is selecting which task types to enable. Each task type gives the AI different capabilities for interacting with your development environment.

step4_launch.text: Step four is the final launch step where you review your configuration and start your AI development session.

temperature_explanation.text: Temperature controls the creativity and randomness of AI responses. Lower values like zero point two give more consistent results, while higher values like zero point eight encourage more creative solutions.

user_settings_intro.text: Before we explore the main workflow, let's look at the user settings where you configure API keys and local tools.

view_output.text: Finally, we can see the output showing that test.txt has been successfully created and updated with our short story.

view_plan.text: The AI has generated a plan for our task. Let us review what it intends to do.

web_search_task_explanation.text: Web Search Task searches Google for information, fetches top results, and analyzes content to provide the AI with current information and documentation.

working_directory_explanation.text: The working directory is where the AI will read and write files. You can specify an existing directory or generate a new timestamped session directory.
